context: Two teens compare school and after-school routines
purpose: Teach: 幾つ/およそ/まことに/どうにも/どれほど/暮らす/但し/かよう

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ陸、最近の放課後ってどんだけ忙しいの？私、塾と部活でどうにも時間が足りなくてさ。
lines.en: Hey Riku, how busy are your afternoons lately? Between cram school and club, I just can't seem to find enough time.
lines.style: Casual teen tone, slightly exasperated and curious, rising intonation at questions, friendly close-friend register

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うちも似たような感じ。塾の科目が幾つもあって、平日はだいたい十時くらいまで勉強してる。
lines.en: Mine's pretty similar. I've got several cram school subjects, and on weekdays I study until around ten.
lines.style: Relaxed teenage boy speech, dropping particles, matter-of-fact delivery with light complaint

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 十時！？マジ尊敬する。私なんて九時過ぎたらもう眠くて、そんな暮らし方続けてたら倒れそう。
lines.en: Ten o'clock?! Seriously, mad respect. Once it hits nine I'm already sleepy. If I kept living like that, I'd collapse.
lines.style: Exaggerated teen shock with playful flattery, slightly dramatic pacing, expressive and theatrical voice

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: でもさ、土日はちゃんと休んでるよ。但し試験前は別。さすがに机にずっと向かって暮らすのは無理だし。
lines.en: But to be fair, I rest properly on weekends. Except before exams. There's no way I could live constantly chained to a desk.
lines.style: Defensive but easygoing pushback, natural teen rhythm, slight chuckle audible in the delivery

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それ正解。お兄ちゃんが受験のとき部屋に閉じこもってて、ほんとどうにもならない感じだったもん。
lines.en: Smart move. When my brother had entrance exams he locked himself in his room, and it was honestly hopeless.
lines.style: Sympathetic teen recollection, lowered voice for serious memory, then casual resumption of tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかる。先輩たちが「睡眠がどれほど大事か思い知るぞ」とか言っててさ、まことにその通りだなって最近思う。
lines.en: Totally. The upperclassmen keep saying 'you'll realize just how important sleep is,' and lately I really think they're right.
lines.style: Reflective teen agreement, quoting senior with mock-formal flourish, slightly slower thoughtful pace

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: じゃあ今度の連休、勉強会しない？図書館で集中して、終わったらカフェ行こうよ。
lines.en: Then how about a study session over the upcoming holiday? Focus at the library, then let's hit a cafe after.
lines.style: Bright teen invitation with rising excitement, plotting-with-a-friend energy, warm closing tone

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: いいね、それ乗った。お互い励まし合えば、およそ二倍ははかどる気がするし。
lines.en: Sounds good, I'm in. If we cheer each other on, I feel like we'll get roughly twice as much done.
lines.style: Enthusiastic agreement, confident teen optimism, slight grin audible in casual delivery

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 決まり！かような名コンビが組めば最強でしょ、って先生っぽく言ってみた。
lines.en: It's settled! 'Such a great duo will be unstoppable'—I tried saying it like a teacher.
lines.style: Playful teen sign-off, mock-formal teacher impression for comic effect, bright cheerful close
